description: This file is a JavaScript module that implements a minimal API client for a frontend application. It provides functions for authentication, chat messaging, document upload, and feedback submission by making HTTP requests to an API server, using fetch. It also manages JWT tokens in memory and localStorage, and references external store module for state management.

methods.name: request(path, { method = 'GET', headers = {}, body, isForm = false } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the API server with specified parameters, handling JSON content and errors.

methods.name: login(username, password)
methods.description: Performs user login, stores JWT token in memory and localStorage.

methods.name: sendChat(message, language)
methods.description: Sends a chat message with a specified language.

methods.name: uploadDocument(file, onProgress)
methods.description: Uploads a file as multipart/form-data, reports progress via callback if provided.

methods.name: submitFeedback(feedback, rating)
methods.description: Sends user feedback and optional rating to the server.
